scope: Reference implementation profile for ordinary isotropic opaque dielectric and metallic reflection under local and image-based lighting; not a universal iridescent or volumetric solver.

mechanisms.implementation: Isotropic GGX NDF; perceptual roughness r mapped to alpha=r*r; alpha clamped to avoid singular evaluation.
mechanisms.limitations: No anisotropy, multiple-scattering energy compensation or spectral microfacet distribution in this candidate.

mechanisms.implementation: Schlick 5th-power Fresnel with approximate F0=0.04 for common nonmetal cases.
mechanisms.limitations: Constant F0 is an artistic interchange convention, not a measured spectral index or exact Fresnel.

mechanisms.implementation: Metallic-roughness RGB F0 mixing for viewport interoperability.
mechanisms.limitations: Not equivalent to spectral complex IOR n(lambda), k(lambda); should not replace the conductor optical operator.

direct_light.geometry: Schlick-Smith k=(r+1)^2/8 for punctual direct lighting only

environment_light.prefiltered_map: Environment cubemap GGX prefiltered by roughness mip; sample by reflection vector.
environment_light.brdf_lut: 2D LUT over NdotV and roughness; scale*F0 + bias.
environment_light.assumption: Historical n=v prefilter approximation; elongated grazing highlights may be lost.

pipeline.color_management: Linear-light evaluation, consistent texture encodings and tone mapping; record renderer color-space settings.

stack.reference: WebGL 2 + GLSL ES 3.00 minimal shader reference on analytic sphere.
stack.baseline_consumer: Three.js MeshStandardMaterial or MeshPhysicalMaterial; adapters must not fork canonical recipe semantics.
stack.fallback: Accessible HTML description and static visual specimen when GPU unavailable.

requirements: Numerically compare GGX D, Schlick F, masking function and grazing-angle stability against independent reference values.
Evaluate direct and IBL separately; compare against importance-sampled reference across at least five roughness values and three view angles.
Render identical geometry and fixed camera/light/environment per specimen; track frame time, GPU compatibility, energy behavior and visual difference.
Test no-GPU fallback and label approximations, measured results and unknowns distinctly.
unverified: No GPU benchmark or validated glTF parity is implied by this seed.
No implementation demonstrates thin film, birefringence, diffraction, scattering or acoustic behavior.

provenance.source: Brian Karis, Real Shading in Unreal Engine 4, SIGGRAPH 2013 slides 5-17
